fix_plan.description: Minimal surgical fix for ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '' in analytics query

files_to_modify.rationale: Attempting int() conversion on empty query string parameters

fix_plan.patch:
--- a/app/services/analytics_service.py
+++ b/app/services/analytics_service.py
@@ -10,6 +10,8 @@
     """Parse integer query parameter with safe default fallback."""
     if raw_val is None:
         return default
+    if isinstance(raw_val, str) and not raw_val.strip():
+        return default
     return int(raw_val)
fix_plan.rationale: Attempting int() conversion on empty query string parameters
